item.title: Our Opinion: ‘Lala’s Law’ could protect missing, endangered kids
item.description: The greatest nightmares communities face always center on the tragedies of children lost and harmed, abused and unprotected, left behind when they should be our ultimate concern.

item.title: Chris Kelly Opinion: A ‘cure’ for data center despair
item.description: Few evils are as demoralizing or debilitating as the toxic “air of inevitability,” a creeping sense that some fights — no matter how righteous — just can’t be won. The grim history of our valley’s exploitation at the greedy hands of rapacious invaders reinforces hereditary self-doubt and normalizes the generational defeatism that has made us easy marks since the Gilded Age of the robber barons. “You can’t fight City Hall,” the bootlickers insist. The rich and powerful will always get their way.

item.title: Shopa-Davey VFW Post 6082 Auxiliary Pocono Cheesecake fundraiser
item.description: VFW Shopa-Davey 6082 Auxiliary, Peckville, will hold a Pocono Cheesecake fundraiser for Lent. Each cheesecake is 6 inches and costs $16. Available flavors are original, Oreo, peanut butter cup and raspberry swirl. Deadline to preorder is March 18. To place preorders, call Pete at 570-335-5551 or the post at 570-383-0501. item.title: WOMEN’S BASKETBALL: Lady Royals down Otterbein, advance to Sweet 16
item.description: SCRANTON — Otterbein University started hot in the NCAA Division III women’s basketball second-round game. But it was only a matter of time before the University of Scranton got rolling. Five players scored in double figures as the Lady Royals posted a methodical 82-43 victory over the Lady Cardinals on Saturday night at the John Long Center. Kaci Kranson led the way with 17 points.
